---
title: "Mermaid out-width"
keep-typ: true
mermaid-format: png
format:
  typst: default
  latex: default
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['image\("[^"]*mermaid-figure-1\.png", width: 50(\.0)?%\)']
        - ['mermaid-figure-1\.png", height:']
    latex:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['\\includegraphics\[width=0\.5\\linewidth,[^\]]*\]\{[^}]*mermaid-figure-1\.png\}']
        - []
---

```{mermaid}
%%| out-width: 50%
flowchart LR
  A --> B
```
